limitations: Native requirement mapping is preserved; independent semantic coverage and targeted positive/negative/equivalent game fixtures have not been qualified.

requirements.obligation: The game process has started.
Natural entry.
Within 2 seconds of the first stable rendered frame, enter one bounded side-view arena with exactly one player fighter on the left and one visually distinct rival fighter on the right.
Both fighters are simultaneously visible, stand on the same readable floor, face each other, and begin separated by at least two fighter widths.
Do not require a menu, character select, console command, network service, or hidden answer control before the round is playable.
Show both fighters, arena bounds or walls, the floor, the control legend `A/D Move  W Jump  J Strike  K Bolt  S Block  R Restart`, and the HUD required by `INTERFACE-01`.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart and Reopen return to the same direct playable arrangement.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Side-view 2.5D or stylized 3D presentation is allowed, using the supplied 3D fighters and animations under `ASSET-01` and `ASSET-02`.
Phase is active; the player is grounded and not in block, hit reaction, or an attack commitment.
Hold `A` or `D`, then release.
Move continuously left or right while held, remain inside the arena, stop horizontal movement after release, and always face toward the rival.
The player cannot pass through the rival, cross an arena wall, continue sliding after release, or turn away from the rival.
Movement must visibly change position; the fighter returns to an idle presentation after release.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Opposite-direction input reverses movement without leaving the arena.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart restores the initial position.
Phase is active and the player is grounded.
Press `W`.
Begin one visible jump, become airborne, then land on the arena floor and return to grounded state.
A second `W` press while airborne cannot create an additional jump or reset upward motion.
Show a distinct airborne pose or vertical displacement and a visible landing.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Repeated grounded presses may create later jumps.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart removes any airborne motion.
Phase is active.
Press `J`.
Attempt one forward close strike.
If the rival is in close range at the strike's single impact moment, reduce rival health by exactly 25 and resolve exactly one rival hit reaction.
One press cannot deal damage more than once, cannot damage from outside close range, and cannot reduce health below 0.
Show a visible strike action.
On hit, show rival hit reaction plus the hit feedback required by `INTERFACE-02`; on miss, show the miss feedback required by `COMBAT-03`.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Further strikes may be attempted after the visible strike commitment ends.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart cancels an in-progress strike and restores health.
Phase is active and the bolt is ready.
Press `K`.
Create exactly one visible player energy bolt moving toward the rival, mark the bolt unavailable for 1.0 second, and keep at most one player bolt active.
A bolt that reaches the rival reduces rival health by exactly 15 once, resolves one hit reaction, and is removed.
The bolt cannot damage more than once, cannot persist after impact or leaving the arena, cannot pass through the rival and later damage again, and cannot reduce health below 0.
Show the travelling bolt, a visible ready/cooldown state, and hit feedback when it connects.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: A new bolt may be fired only after no earlier player bolt remains and the 1.0-second cooldown has expired.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart removes every bolt and makes the action ready.
Phase is active.
A close strike reaches its impact moment outside close range, or `K` is pressed while a bolt is active or its cooldown has not expired.
Preserve both fighters' health and object counts except for the normal removal of a missed bolt at the arena boundary.
A rejected `K` press creates no new bolt and does not reset or extend the existing cooldown.
Misses and rejected inputs cannot cause hidden damage, duplicate projectiles, or false hit reactions.
A close miss shows a brief `WHIFF` indication; a rejected bolt shows a brief `COOLDOWN` indication.
Neither indication may claim a hit.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Repeated rejected presses remain side-effect free.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart clears both indications.
Phase is active.
Natural time progression.
The stationary rival begins its first pulse telegraph 3.0 seconds after the round becomes active and begins each later telegraph 3.0 seconds after the previous pulse resolves.
Each telegraph lasts 0.75 seconds, then one pulse resolves against the player.
An unblocked pulse reduces player health by exactly 20 once.
The rival cannot chase, jump, fire extra pulses, deal damage before the telegraph finishes, deal multiple damage from one pulse, or continue its cadence after a terminal result.
During the full telegraph, show a clearly visible warning on or around the rival.
On an unblocked hit, show player hit reaction and the feedback required by `INTERFACE-02`.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Timing tolerance is plus or minus 0.15 seconds for the 3.0-second interval and plus or minus 0.10 seconds for the 0.75-second telegraph.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart begins a new cadence with no inherited pulse.
Phase is active.
Hold `S` before a rival pulse impact and keep it held through the impact.
Enter a visible blocking state while held.
A pulse resolved during that state deals exactly 0 health damage, produces one guard resolution, and then continues the normal rival cadence.
Releasing `S` returns the player to idle if no other state applies.
Blocking cannot heal, damage the rival, create a projectile, move the player, or remain active after `S` is released.
A press begun after pulse impact cannot retroactively block that pulse.
Show an unmistakable block pose while held and a brief guard flash plus `BLOCKED` feedback when the pulse resolves.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Holding block across multiple later pulses may block each pulse.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart clears block even if the key was held before restart.
A fresh round begins.
Natural round initialization and later damage.
Set player health and rival health to exactly 100.

Apply only the damage values defined by `COMBAT-01`, `COMBAT-02`, and `DEFENSE-01`; clamp both health values to the inclusive range 0 through 100; and update health truth and HUD in the same visible update.
Health cannot become negative, exceed 100, change without a defined damage event or restart, or disagree with the visible HUD.
Show numeric health and proportional bars for both fighters.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Repetition remains deterministic under the same input timing.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart and Reopen restore both values to 100.
Phase is active.
Natural update.
Keep exactly one player fighter and one rival fighter.
The rival remains at its initial horizontal position except for a short visual hit reaction; the player cannot push it to a new resting position.
Do not spawn replacement fighters, helper fighters, or hidden damage actors that persist as additional fighters.
Both fighters remain identifiable and visible except for momentary effects that do not hide the duel.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart removes transient combat objects and restores the same two-fighter arrangement.
A round exists.
Natural state changes.
Continuously show player health, rival health, and bolt state as `READY` or a remaining cooldown indication.
During a terminal result, continue showing the final health values.
The HUD cannot display stale, rounded-to-a-different-damage-step, or fabricated values.
Use readable labels and bars that distinguish player from rival at 1280 x 720.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart immediately restores `100`, `100`, and `READY`.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Reopen shows the same fresh values.
Phase is active or has just become terminal.
A strike, bolt, pulse, block, miss, cooldown rejection, or KO resolves.

Provide feedback matching the resolution: visible hit flash/reaction for damage, guard flash plus `BLOCKED` for a block, `WHIFF` for an out-of-range close strike, `COOLDOWN` for a rejected bolt, and a result banner for KO.
Short-lived nonterminal text remains visible for at least 0.30 seconds and no longer than 1.25 seconds.
Feedback cannot claim damage, block, or KO when the corresponding state transition did not occur.
Feedback is readable without opening logs or developer tools.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Later feedback may replace earlier short-lived feedback.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart clears every transient and terminal message.
Phase is active and at least one fighter has positive health.
A defined damage event reduces one fighter to 0.
Resolve exactly one result: rival health 0 and player health above 0 produces player win; player health 0 and rival health above 0 produces rival win.
If both reach 0 in the same update, produce `DRAW`.
Show the matching banner `PLAYER WINS`, `RIVAL WINS`, or `DRAW`.
The result cannot contradict final health and cannot fire more than once for the same round.
Keep final health visible and show the result banner within 0.5 seconds of the decisive damage update.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: `R` remains available through `LIFECYCLE-01`.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Reopen follows `LIFECYCLE-02`.
A result from `TERMINAL-01` has resolved.
Natural time progression and any `A`, `D`, `W`, `J`, `K`, or `S` input.
Keep both health values, result, fighter count, and final positions stable until `R` is pressed or the process closes.
Remove active bolts and cancel the rival cadence.
Movement, jump, attack, block, damage, healing, new projectile creation, or a second result cannot occur during the terminal state.
The result banner remains visible; fighters may hold a win, loss, or draw pose.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Waiting at least 3.5 seconds after the result must not permit an old rival pulse to change the terminal state.
A process is running in an active or terminal round.
Press `R` once.

Within 1.0 second, create a new round identity and restore the direct playable state: both health values 100, initial positions, grounded idle player, stationary idle rival, bolt ready, no projectile, no telegraph, no block, no transient feedback, no result, and a fresh 3.0-second rival cadence.
The new round cannot inherit health, motion, held block, cooldown, projectile, telegraph, result, or delayed damage from the old round.
The HUD and arena visibly return to the fresh state.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Repeated `R` presses create later clean rounds.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Old delayed events remain unable to affect them.
The game process has been closed normally after any active or terminal progress.
Start a new process using the documented runtime entry.
Enter a fresh round with the same state listed in `LIFECYCLE-01`, a new process identity, and no retained match progress.
A new process cannot restore prior health, positions, cooldown, projectile, telegraph, result, or round identity.
The first playable view is the fresh arena and HUD rather than a resume prompt.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: This task has no save-progress requirement.
The arena is visible.
Natural entry and continued play.
Both fighters visibly use the supplied `SKM_Manny` 3D skeletal character model, with its recognizable body shape and articulated limbs.
Keep the player and rival visually distinct through color or material treatment.
Primitives, sprites, flat images, unrelated meshes, or hidden/off-screen instances of the supplied model cannot substitute for either visible fighter.
Merely importing or referencing the model is not sufficient.
The supplied model is the visible body of each fighter throughout the duel.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Reuse the same model for both fighters.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Color changes, uniform scaling, and supplemental effects are allowed; replacing its recognizable shape is not.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart and Reopen preserve this presentation.
A fighter is visible in a state already required by this section.
Idle; player movement, jump, strike, bolt, or block; either fighter receiving a hit.

Visibly animate the supplied model with `AS_manny_stand` for idle, `AS_manny_fwalk` for movement toward the rival, `AS_manny_bwalk` for movement away from the rival, `AS_manny_jump` for jumping, `AS_manny_5a` for the close strike, `AS_manny_fireball` for bolt casting, `AS_manny_standblock` for standing guard, and `AS_manny_hitstun` for hit reaction.
All eight supplied clips must be used for these roles.
A static model, unrelated replacement animation, or clips that are imported but never visibly played do not satisfy this requirement.
Damage-free whiffs and rejected actions cannot trigger a false hit reaction.
The supplied clips make the corresponding existing actions or states recognizable on screen.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Blending, looping, pose holds, and playback-rate adjustment are allowed when they preserve the recognizable motion and existing numbered rules.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Clip duration does not set gameplay timing, damage, collision, or cooldown.

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Restart cancels an old action presentation and restores idle

requirements.field: Failure, Repetition, Restart, or Other Boundary
requirements.obligation: Reopen retains the same asset use.
The project can start, run, exit, and start again by following the public instructions.
The main flow uses normal player input and does not depend on an answer button, cheat entry, or direct gameplay-result call.
Critical entries, text, controls, and feedback are visible, discoverable, readable, and operable.
Player actions produce perceptible feedback, and visible feedback remains consistent with true game state.
No severe error blocks the main flow.
Repeated runs from the same initial conditions produce substantially stable results.

qualification_test_scope: Distribution, evidence conversion and attribution invariants only; not gameplay semantic qualification.
